name: seated knee flexor stretch
description: A seated reach toward the toes that lengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
